title: James Hector's geological map of New Zealand
credit: James Hector; engraved by Emery Walker; Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th edition, volume 19, p. 625
altText: Historic 1884 geological map of New Zealand with geological regions shaded.
caption: Geological map of New Zealand originally dated 1884, associated with James Hector and published in the 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica.
context: An early example of nationally organised thematic geographic information. It predates computer mapping.
